title: Design and synthesis of oxathiapiprolin derivatives containing acetal fragments as potent fungicide candidates.
authors: Li, Hong-Hao; Yang, Jin-Peng; Cheng, Chuan-Xiang; Zhang, Lan; Gong, Chao; Ye, Ying; Liu, Xi-Li; W Kandegama, Wm Wishwajith; Zhu, Xiao-Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究含缩醛片段的Oxathiapiprolin衍生物作为杀菌剂，涉及与氧甾醇结合蛋白的分子对接，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Oxysterol-binding proteins (OSBPs) serve as critical regulators throughout the oomycete life cycle. Oxathiapiprolin (OXA), a potent OSBP-targeting fungicide, represents the first commercially developed piperidine-thiazole-isooxazoline (PTI) product. Despite extensive structural modification focused on OXA, very few analogs with improved fungicidal activity have been identified to date. RESULTS: In this study, a series of OXA derivatives were designed and synthesized by introducing a flexible acetal fragment into OXA. The compounds B3 and B5 respectively exhibited excellent 77.78% and 94.44% control efficiency against cucumber downy mildew (CDM) at 0.02 mg/L concentration. The field trials showed that compounds B3 and B5 took on higher control efficiency than OXA at the same concentration. The result of environmental toxicological risk assessment indicated that compounds B3 and B5 have lower toxicity to aquatic lives than OXA. Computational chemistry indicated that the binding mode of compound B3 with Phytophthora capsici OSBP (PcOSBP) is similar to that of OXA, and kept the main binding interaction with OSBPs. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggested that a strategy focused on increasing molecular flexibility could be advantageous for optimizing OSBP inhibitors. The chemical structure of compound B3 may serve as a promising new starting point for the development of further OSBP inhibitors. (c) 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
abstract_zh: 背景：氧甾醇结合蛋白（OSBPs）在卵菌生命周期中充当关键调控因子。Oxathiapiprolin（OXA）是一种靶向OSBP的高效杀菌剂，代表了首个商业化开发的哌啶-噻唑-异噁唑啉（PTI）产品。尽管针对OXA进行了广泛的结构修饰，但迄今为止，具有改善杀菌活性的类似物极少被发现。结果：在本研究中，通过在OXA中引入柔性缩醛片段，设计并合成了一系列OXA衍生物。化合物B3和B5在0.02 mg/L浓度下，分别对黄瓜霜霉病（CDM）表现出优异的77.78%和94.44%防治效果。田间试验表明，在相同浓度下，化合物B3和B5的防治效果高于OXA。环境毒理学风险评估结果显示，化合物B3和B5对水生生物的毒性低于OXA。计算化学表明，化合物B3与辣椒疫霉OSBP（PcOSBP）的结合模式与OXA相似，并保持了与OSBPs的主要结合相互作用。结论：我们的发现表明，以增加分子柔性为重点的策略可能有利于优化OSBP抑制剂。化合物B3的化学结构可作为进一步开发OSBP抑制剂的有前景的新起点。（c）2026 化学工业学会。
